# Minecraft console log (stdout → `docker logs`) as it REALLY looks.
#
# The first lines are verbatim from `docker logs`; the player lines are reproduced in the SAME
# format, because the captured log contained no player events.
#
# The point of this fixture: the prefix is `[HH:MM:SS INFO]:` — NOT `[HH:MM:SS] [Server
# thread/INFO]:`. The latter is what `logs/latest.log` contains, not stdout, and stdout is what
# the driver reads.
#
# Lines without '#' are test data.

[20:36:53 INFO]: ThreadedAnvilChunkStorage (world): All chunks are saved
